title: Implement pre-call auto-compact orchestration
objective: Move automatic compaction into the same pre-model-call pipeline position as TS and add the missing orchestration guards and lifecycle behavior.
implementation_scope: Create an AutoCompactIfNeeded service/function that runs after boundary projection, tool-result budget, microcompact, and optional snip/collapse projection, but before provider CreateStream.
Respect DISABLE_COMPACT and DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT equivalents plus user config if Go has one.
Add querySource recursion guards for compact and session-memory paths, and any Go subagent/context-agent equivalents.
Thread AutoCompactTracking state with compacted flag, turn counter, turn id, and consecutive failures.
Try session-memory compaction first when task_14 is available; otherwise keep a no-op hook with explicit TODO and tests.
On success, emit/yield post-compact messages and continue the same query with those messages.
On failure, increment circuit breaker and do not force-truncate unless a later explicit hard-limit fallback owns it.
out_of_scope: Do not implement reactive prompt-too-long recovery in this task.
Do not implement session memory internals here.
acceptance_criteria: Auto-compact can occur before a no-tool assistant response would otherwise return.
Auto-compact does not run inside compact/session-memory query sources.
Consecutive failure circuit breaker stops repeated compact attempts after the configured limit.
Successful auto-compact resets failure count and replaces messages via BuildPostCompactMessages.
risks: Changing call order can affect prompt cache and tool visibility.
Need careful event/yield behavior so UI and session persistence both see boundary and summary messages.
dispatch_prompt: Implement TS-equivalent autoCompactIfNeeded orchestration before provider calls in the Go query loop, with recursion guards, tracking, and circuit breaker behavior.
